hospital.date_basis: HHS report date. Admission field refers to previous calendar day and is grouped by report date.
hospital.source_description: State aggregates with up to four days of carried facility reports, variable contributor counts, and no adjustment for nonresponse.

testing.date_basis: Usually result completion or return to the patient. Specimen collection, receipt or order dates can substitute.
testing.location_basis: Usually patient residence, with provider or laboratory state substituted when unavailable
testing.source_description: Reported PCR specimen results. Coverage and dating vary. Repeat specimens can belong to the same person.

vaccination.date_basis: CDC COVID Data Tracker report date
vaccination.location_basis: Resident jurisdiction for primary series completion and administered jurisdiction for doses
vaccination.source_description: Cumulative reported series completion and doses. Reporting cadence and known caps change over time.

week_anchor: Monday, group on each source date; no cross-source join
hospital_sentinel: Any negative level is unavailable with its original raw value retained only in source bytes.
hospital_confirmed_admission_coverage: Provider metadata for the confirmed coverage field describes suspected admissions. Preserve raw column and do not use for denominator or coverage inference.
interval_hospital: Seven report dates with supported nonnegative values. Ratios use only the provider matched numerator, denominator, and coverage.
interval_testing: Seven result dates each for positive and negative; exclude inconclusive from denominator, withhold if any negative reported result count or denominator zero.
interval_vaccination: Latest reported snapshot per state-week. Signed changes are between consecutive available source reports and gaps in days are explicit.
